traits.name: Bonded Weapon
traits.text:
The spellblade has a magical bond
with its weapon. Unless incapacitated, the
spellblade cannot be disarmed and can summon its
weapon as a bonus action as long as it is on the
same plane of existence.

traits.name: Second Wind (1/Short Rest)
traits.text:
As a bonus action, the
spellblade can regain 1d10 + 6 hit points.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The spellblade is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The spellblade has the following wizard spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, shocking grasp * 1st level (3 slots): detect magic, feather fall, jump, shield

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The spellblade makes two attacks with
its longsword, or casts a cantrip and makes a
longsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage,
or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two
hands.

actions.name: Action Surge (1/Short Rest)
actions.text:
The spellblade makes
four longsword attacks.
